hero_conventions.description: PDP gallery only: recurring hero framing conventions observed across images

position.description: 0-based index matching the order images were attached (image 0 first)

role.description: Free-text functional role (e.g. styled room hero, fabric close-up, size chart). Prefer functional families over angle/crop variants.

kind.description: Coarse type observed for this image (e.g. hero, lifestyle, detail, infographic, comparison, feature_banner)

content_tags.description: Open-vocabulary concrete elements visible (bed, room, fabric, text-overlay, table, dimensions). Tag a person only if a human is visibly present.

text_present.description: True when readable text or printed board content is visible on the image

board.description: Required when text_present is true; omit or leave empty when false

board_type.description: Free text: size chart, comparison table, feature callouts, care guide, etc.

facts.description: Actual data points printed on the image

layout.description: Short layout description (split panel, 2x2 grid, annotated product)
